job.question: What evaluation criteria and percentage weights does the Santa Barbara County Employees' Retirement System (SBCERS) global custody RFP use to evaluate respondents?
job.expected_facts: 1. Scope Affirmation, Servicing Approach, and Institutional Credentials - 30%; 2. Core and Value Added Services and Technology Platforms - 40%; 3. Quality of Responses and Additional Evidence of Capability - 5%; 4. Competitiveness and Reasonableness of Economics - 25%.
job.acceptance: All four categories and 30/40/5/25%; allow synonymous category descriptions.

reviews.reason: This is the Retirement Plan for CTA Employees’ investment consulting RFP, not SBCERS’s global custody RFP. Its evaluation section does not provide the four requested categories or percentage weights.
quotes: Retirement Plan for CTA Employees Investment Consulting Request for Proposals
The Retirement Plan for CTA Employees (the “Plan”) is requesting proposals from qualified professional firms interested in providing Investment Consulting Services to the Plan.

Each proposal received in response to the RFP will be objectively evaluated and rated according to the Firm’s approach and process, it’s staff, the experience of its Firm, and the results of reference checks and fees.
